name: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets
summary: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets is a popular open-air outlet shopping destination in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, offering designer and brand-name stores with everyday savings of 25-65%. With over 11,000 positive reviews and convenient Interstate 20 access, it serves as a regional hub for value-conscious shoppers seeking quality merchandise at outlet prices.
demographics: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of value-conscious shoppers from the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, with a strong representation of middle-income families and millennials seeking designer brands at discounted prices. The trade area draws heavily from Grand Prairie's growing Hispanic population (over 45% of the city) as well as suburban families from Arlington, Irving, and southern Dallas. Visitors typically include bargain hunters aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $85,000 who prioritize value shopping and are willing to drive 20-30 minutes for significant savings on brand-name merchandise.
description: Grand Prairie Premium Outlets stands as one of the premier outlet shopping destinations in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, strategically located along West Interstate 20 for easy access from throughout the region. As part of the renowned Premium Outlets collection, this open-air shopping center offers an exceptional outlet shopping experience featuring a curated selection of designer and brand-name stores offering savings of 25% to 65% every day. The center's thoughtfully designed layout creates an inviting atmosphere for shoppers seeking everything from fashion and accessories to footwear and housewares, all at outlet prices. With its convenient location between Dallas and Fort Worth, the outlet center serves as a regional shopping hub that draws visitors from across North Texas who appreciate the combination of quality brands and value pricing. The property has earned an impressive 4.4-star rating from over 11,000 reviews, reflecting its popularity as a go-to destination for savvy shoppers looking to maximize their purchasing power while enjoying a pleasant outdoor shopping environment.
